text:
Family Office | AI-Native Technical Operations Lead | Miami, FL (ONSITE preferred, REMOTE US considered) | $90-150K + Equity | Contract-to-hire

We're a fully capitalized HealthTech platform backed by a Miami-based family office, building an AI-native SaaS product from the ground up. Not a legacy system with AI bolted on — AI is core to the architecture and the development workflow.

Hiring our first technical operations hire. Think studio engineer to a recording artist: you own environment prep, QA, testing, CI/CD, compliance documentation, and 30-40% independent development so engineering leadership stays focused on high-leverage product work. Ground-floor equity opportunity.

Hard requirement: you must already be building software with AI coding tools daily (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot). Not interested in AI — actively shipping with it. If you can't show us something you built with AI tools in the last 60 days, this isn't the right fit.

Looking for: 3-7 years full-stack experience, strong QA discipline, DevOps comfort (Docker, CI/CD, cloud), polyglot across languages/frameworks, self-directed.

Interview: 15-min screen (show us your AI-built work) → take-home exercise → 2-hour paid working session → culture fit.

Will cover relocation if needed to Miami, FL.

Email: jpd@direzzefamilyoffice.com
